idCitation.resTitle: primary census abstrct data (demographic data) Census of India 2001

dataIdInfo.idPurp: This map shows the administrative boundaries of all the villages of India. The primary census abstract data of Census 2001 has been linked to the villages and towns.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This map contains the data on primary census abstract such as population, literacy, Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Caste and Workers. Its also contains population of below 6 years age male female. The Primary Census Abstract data linked to village shape file of all india.

searchKeys.keyword: Census data (2001) for Village of India
